subject: maths
question: Ajay, Vijay and Sashi can do a piece of work in 20,40 and 60 days, respectively. In how many days can Ajay do the work if he is assisted by Vijay and Sashi on every fourth day?
solution:
Given:

Ajay takes = 20 days

Vijay takes = 40 days

Sashi takes = 60 days

Vijay and Sashi assisted on every fourth day.

Calculation:

Total work = LCM(20, 40, 60) = 120 unit

Efficiency of Ajay = 120/20 = 6

Efficiency of Vijay = 120/40 = 3
